ms.report:
all the functionalities for the Hotel Guest App are implemented.
Here are links to evidences
・Link of working prototype including all the functionalities - 
・A demo booking link to initiate the process - this is done to facilitate a booking for demo purpose. https://booking.cloud10hospitality.com/booking make a booking for current date as checking date and need to put a valid email to receive link for check-in process. In real implementation bookings will be generated from hotel booking engine or online travel agencies. Current logic trigger check-in link for when check-in date is within 24 hours. The time is configurable by Hotel/property. 
・Once the booking is done using above link, a link is received in email, follow the link for rest of the check-in process.
・Link for SSID wallet https://booking.cloud10hospitality.com/wallet 
・ Link to Video for the application demo showing all the functionalities developed. https://www.canva.com/design/DAGxPt6mhYw/48qWwG6tKoL_cJHnLlyqKQ/watch
・Link to Smart Contract repository https://github.com/AIQUANT-Tech/HGE_SC ( Smart Contract code repository is public, all other code is private repository)
